title: Made a Crazy Taxi game that expanded into a bunch of other stuff...
author: mallclerks
selftext:
I've been testing the simple prompt of 'make a Crazy Taxi' clone for the last few generations.  This is the first time I actually enjoyed playing it, and then both of my kids have been addicted to it for the past few days. Before my 5yr old goes to bed, we discuss what he wants me to add in.

It started as Crazy Taxi. We then added in some GTA like features, which then turned into letting you be the cop chasing the bad guys.  Which turned into an entire scenario based experience where you do a lot of different stuff cops would do.  There is very basic air modes.

Honestly, I just enjoy free play. Every time I have Claude do anything, I have a note for him to always add 2-5 new features, never to tell me about them.  Every single time I try the game, I find new things, easter eggs, little improvements. It's been a blast.  Figured someone, somewhere, may get a few minutes of enjoyment.
